data.title: v0 runway plan
data.summary: Next-step ranking by ROI · fleet-dispatch table · review rubric.

sections.body: L1 + L2 mirrors complete (11,573 shots). Tokenizer stack landed: Open-MAGVIT2 frames, Chronos signals, PatchTST, alignment.py, missing-modality padding (72c0e0a), plasma-domain decoder fine-tune scaffold (5e7c5fc). Bench YAML configs landed (dec0082). Quality audit recalibrated against FAIR-MAST xarray-on-Zarr (d3896e5). Exclusive compute authorised 2026-05-26. Bulk-encode in flight (Agent D). Training-grade derivation in flight (Agent A). SLURM wrapper set landing (Agent B). 125M smoke run queued — gated on Agent D + Agent A.

ROI = value × probability of clean delivery / cost. Updated 2026-05-26: exclusive compute live, bulk-encode ACTIVE (rank 9), 125M smoke queued (rank 10). Ranks 6/7/8 now DONE. Demo CLI (rank 12) DONE.

Four Sonnet 4.6 agents in parallel with non-overlapping write scopes. Coordinator (Opus) reviews each post-completion. §3.1 coordinator review completed 2026-05-26: all 4 commits accepted. Rubric (1)–(3) pass; (4) failed (none wrote followup — known pattern).

Every dispatched agent's output is reviewed against: (1) does it land what the plan promised, (2) are tests green, (3) is the commit message scoped right, (4) did it update the plan's followup chain. Failures are captured in a new feedback memory.

notes.body: Adding §3 fleet-dispatch as a sub-plan; agent boundary table makes the parallelism real.

followups.title: Coordinator review of the 4-agent parallel batch outputs
followups.body: All 4 Sonnet agents have committed their work. Review each output against the §5 rubric and either accept the commits or flag for rework. Update §2 ROI ranking with the new items the batch produced.
followups.prompt:
Project: imas-ambix
Plan: v0-runway

Coordinator review of the 4-agent parallel batch (see §3 fleet-dispatch).
For each of the 4 commits, score against §5 review rubric:
  (1) lands what plan promised
  (2) tests green
  (3) commit message scoped right
  (4) followup chain updated
Output a §3.1 summary table; flag any rework as new followups on the owning plan.
followups.outcome: All 4 S2 batch commits accepted. Rubric scores: 5e7c5fc (decoder fine-tune scaffold) — 1:pass 2:pass 3:pass 4:fail; 72c0e0a (alignment + padding) — 1:pass 2:pass 3:pass 4:fail; dec0082 (bench YAML configs) — 1:pass 2:pass 3:pass 4:fail; d3896e5 (quality recalibration) — 1:pass 2:pass 3:pass 4:fail. All 4 failed item (4) — followup chain not updated (known Sonnet fleet pattern). 368 tests collected clean (EXIT=0), 1 GPU skip. §1 refreshed to 2026-05-26. §2 bulk-encode now ACTIVE. §3.1 table written to v0-runway.html. impl advanced to 0.78.

followups.title: Second coordinator review — gate the 125M smoke-run dispatch
followups.body: Agent D bulk-encode and Agent A training-grade derivation are both in flight. Once they land, review their outputs and dispatch the 125M smoke training run. Verify: (1) bulk-encode token count is plausible (expect ~9k tokens/shot * 11k shots), (2) training-grade-shots.json is populated with shot IDs + quality flags, (3) SLURM wrappers from Agent B are present and functional, (4) smoke run can be dispatched on 1 GPU with 100 shots.
followups.est_turn: single Opus turn after Agent A + D complete
